names: Mother of Emperor Gaozu and Liu Jiao
Son of the Marquis of De

value.event: The source says only that this occurred while Gaozu was not yet eminent; it supplies no Western-year interval.
The source identifies Liu Jiao as Gaozu’s younger brother by the same mother and preserves the undated pre-imperial anecdote; no personal Western activity interval is asserted for their mother.
The source says that Bo died early and preserves the undated pre-imperial anecdote; no Western activity interval is asserted.
The source preserves an undated pre-imperial anecdote about Bo’s wife; no Western activity interval is asserted.

sourceDate.text: 拜禮為楚王…文王立三年
高后王呂祿於趙，一歲而高后崩
孝文帝即位二年…立十三年

value.event: The source says only that Zhao’s king was penalized during Emperor Jing’s reign on account of Chao Cuo; it supplies no year for Chao Cuo’s activity.
The source attributes the concluding commentary to the Grand Historian without dating its composition or the author’s activity.
The concluding retrospective says that King Wu punished Master Shen; it does not date the counsel or punishment to the Seven States rebellion.
The concluding retrospective says Zhao employed Master Fangyu; it does not date that employment to the Seven States rebellion.

sourceDate.text: 孝景帝時坐晁錯以適削趙王常山之郡
吳楚反，趙王遂與合謀起兵

units.zh: 楚元王劉交者，高祖之同母少弟也，字游。
units.en: Liu Jiao, King Yuan of Chu, was the youngest brother of Emperor Gaozu by the same mother, and bore the courtesy name You.
units.literal: King Yuan of Chu, Liu Jiao, was Gaozu's younger brother by the same mother, styled You.

units.zh: 高祖兄弟四人，長兄伯，伯蚤卒。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu had four brothers in all. The eldest, Bo, died young.
units.literal: Gaozu had four brothers: the eldest was Bo, who died young.

units.zh: 始高祖微時，嘗辟事，時時與賓客過巨嫂食。
units.en: In the early days, when Gaozu was still a man of humble station, he would shirk his duties and often bring guests to dine at his eldest brother's wife's home.
units.literal: When Gaozu was still of humble status, he once avoided official duties and frequently went with guests to eat at his elder brother's wife's house.

units.zh: 嫂厭叔，叔與客來，嫂詳為羹盡，櫟釜，賓客以故去。
units.en: His sister-in-law grew tired of her brother-in-law. Whenever he arrived with guests, she would pretend the stew had run out and scrape the pot loudly, so the guests would take their leave.
units.literal: The sister-in-law disliked her husband's younger brother. When he came with guests, she pretended the stew was gone and scraped the pot, so the guests left.

units.zh: 已而視釜中尚有羹，高祖由此怨其嫂。
units.en: But when they looked in the pot afterward, there was still plenty of stew. From that day on, Gaozu bore a grudge against his sister-in-law.
units.literal: Later, when they checked the pot, there was still stew left. From this, Gaozu resented his sister-in-law.

units.zh: 及高祖為帝，封昆弟，而伯子獨不得封。
units.en: When Gaozu became emperor and enfeoffed his brothers, Bo's son alone received no fief.
units.literal: When Gaozu became emperor, he enfeoffed his brothers, but Bo's son alone did not receive an enfeoffment.

units.zh: 太上皇以為言，高祖曰：「某非忘封之也，為其母不長者耳。」
units.en: The Retired Emperor raised the matter, and Gaozu replied, "It is not that I forgot to grant him a fief—it is because his mother was no woman of virtue."
units.literal: The Supreme Emperor spoke of this, and Gaozu said, "It is not that I forgot to enfeoff him; it is because his mother was not virtuous."

units.zh: 於是乃封其子信為羹頡侯。
units.en: He then enfeoffed Bo's son Xin as the Marquis of Gengjie.
units.literal: Therefore, he enfeoffed Bo's son Xin as Marquis of Gengjie.

units.zh: 而王次兄仲於代。
units.en: His second brother, Zhong, was made King of Dai.
units.literal: He then established his second brother Zhong as king in Dai.

units.zh: 高祖六年，已禽楚王韓信於陳，乃以弟交為楚王，都彭城。
units.en: In the sixth year of Gaozu's reign, having captured Han Xin, the King of Chu, at Chen, the emperor appointed his brother Jiao as King of Chu, with his capital at Pengcheng.
units.literal: In Gaozu's sixth year, after capturing the Chu king Han Xin at Chen, he made his brother Jiao King of Chu, with his capital at Pengcheng.

units.zh: 即位二十三年卒，子夷王郢立。
units.en: After twenty-three years on the throne, he died, and his son Ying succeeded him as King Yi.
units.literal: He reigned for twenty-three years and died. His son, King Yi Ying, succeeded him.

units.zh: 夷王四年卒，子王戊立。
units.en: King Yi reigned for four years before his death, and his son Wu succeeded him.
units.literal: King Yi reigned for four years and died. His son, King Wu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 王戊立二十年，冬，坐為薄太后服私姦，削東海郡。
units.en: In the twentieth year of King Wu's reign, during winter, he was found guilty of committing adultery during the mourning period for Empress Dowager Bo, and the commandery of Donghai was stripped from him.
units.literal: King Wu reigned for twenty years. In winter, he was convicted of committing adultery while mourning Empress Bo, and Donghai commandery was stripped from him.

units.zh: 春，戊與吳王合謀反，其相張尚、太傅趙夷吾諫，不聽。
units.en: In spring, King Wu of Chu joined the King of Wu in a conspiracy to rebel. His chancellor Zhang Shang and Grand Tutor Zhao Yiwu remonstrated with him, but he refused to listen.
units.literal: In spring, King Wu joined the King of Wu in conspiring to rebel. His chancellor Zhang Shang and tutor Zhao Yiwu advised against it, but he would not listen.

units.zh: 戊則殺尚、夷吾，起兵與吳西攻梁，破棘壁。
units.en: Wu had Shang and Yiwu executed, raised his troops, and marched west with the forces of Wu against Liang, breaching the fortifications at Jibi.
units.literal: King Wu then executed Shang and Yiwu, raised troops, and marched west with the King of Wu against Liang, breaking through Jibi.

units.zh: 至昌邑南，與漢將周亞夫戰。
units.en: They advanced as far south as Changyi, where they engaged the Han general Zhou Yafu in battle.
units.literal: They reached south of Changyi and fought with the Han general Zhou Yafu.

units.zh: 漢絕吳楚糧道，士卒饑，吳王走，楚王戊自殺，軍遂降漢。
units.en: The Han forces cut off the supply lines of Wu and Chu. The soldiers starved. The King of Wu fled, and King Wu of Chu took his own life. The army then surrendered to Han.
units.literal: Han cut off Wu and Chu's supply lines. The soldiers grew hungry. The King of Wu fled. King Wu of Chu committed suicide. The army surrendered to Han.

units.zh: 漢已平吳楚，孝景帝欲以德侯子續吳，以元王子禮續楚。
units.en: After Han had pacified Wu and Chu, Emperor Jing wished to restore the line of Wu through the son of the Marquis of De, and the line of Chu through King Yuan's son Liu Li.
units.literal: After Han pacified Wu and Chu, Emperor Jing wanted to continue Wu with the son of Marquis De, and continue Chu with King Yuan's son Liu Li.

units.zh: 竇太后曰：「吳王，老人也，宜為宗室順善。
units.en: Empress Dowager Dou said, "The King of Wu was an elder of the realm. He should have been a model of obedience and virtue among the imperial clan.
units.literal: Empress Dou said: "The King of Wu was an old man, he should have been compliant and virtuous within the imperial clan.

units.zh: 今乃首率七國，紛亂天下，柰何續其後！」
units.en: Instead, he took the lead in rallying seven states to throw the realm into chaos—how can we perpetuate his line!"
units.literal: Now he was the first to lead the seven states in throwing the realm into chaos—how can we continue his descendants!"

units.zh: 不許吳，許立楚後。
units.en: The request for Wu was denied, but permission was granted to continue the line of Chu.
units.literal: Wu was not allowed, but Chu was permitted to establish descendants.

units.zh: 是時禮為漢宗正。
units.en: At that time, Li was serving as the Director of the Imperial Clan for the Han court.
units.literal: At this time Li served as Han's Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 乃拜禮為楚王，奉元王宗廟，是為楚文王。
units.en: Li was then appointed King of Chu to carry on the ancestral sacrifices of King Yuan, and he became known as King Wen of Chu.
units.literal: Li was appointed King of Chu to maintain King Yuan's ancestral temples, and became King Wen of Chu.

units.zh: 文王立三年卒，子安王道立。
units.en: King Wen reigned for three years before his death. His son Dao succeeded him as King An.
units.literal: King Wen reigned for three years and died. His son, King An Dao, succeeded him.

units.zh: 安王二十二年卒，子襄王注立。
units.en: King An reigned for twenty-two years and died. His son Zhu succeeded him as King Xiang.
units.literal: King An reigned for twenty-two years and died. His son, King Xiang Zhu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 襄王立十四年卒，子王純代立。
units.en: King Xiang reigned for fourteen years and died, and his son Chun took the throne.
units.literal: King Xiang reigned for fourteen years and died. His son, King Chun, succeeded him.

units.zh: 王純立，地節二年，中人上書告楚王謀反，王自殺，國除，入漢為彭城郡。
units.en: After King Chun took the throne, in the second year of the Dijie era, a palace attendant submitted a memorial accusing the King of Chu of plotting rebellion. The king took his own life, the state was abolished, and its territory became the Pengcheng commandery under Han.
units.literal: King Chun ascended the throne. In the second year of the Dijie era, a palace attendant submitted a memorial accusing the King of Chu of plotting rebellion. The king committed suicide. The state was abolished and became Pengcheng commandery of Han.

units.zh: 趙王劉遂者，其父高祖中子，名友，謚曰「幽」。
units.en: Liu Sui, King of Zhao—his father was the middle son of Emperor Gaozu, named You, who was given the posthumous title of You, 'the Secluded.'
units.literal: King Zhao Liu Sui—his father was Gaozu's middle son, whose personal name was You and whose posthumous title was You, "the Secluded."

units.zh: 幽王以憂死，故為「幽」。
units.en: King You died of grief, and so received the posthumous name 'the Secluded.'
units.literal: King You died of sorrow, hence "You."

units.zh: 高后王呂祿於趙，一歲而高后崩。
units.en: Empress Dowager Gao installed Lü Lu as King of Zhao, but within a year she passed away.
units.literal: Empress Gao established Lü Lu as king in Zhao, and after one year Empress Gao passed away.

units.zh: 大臣誅諸呂呂祿等，乃立幽王子遂為趙王。
units.en: The great ministers put to death the Lu clansmen, including Lu Lu, and then established Sui, son of King You, as King of Zhao.
units.literal: The ministers executed the various Lü clansmen including Lü Lu, and established King You's son Sui as King of Zhao.

units.zh: 孝文帝即位二年，立遂弟辟彊，取趙之河閒郡為河閒王，（以）［是］為文王。
units.en: In the second year after Emperor Wen took the throne, he established Sui's younger brother Piqiang as King of Hejian, carving out the Hejian commandery from Zhao for this purpose. He became known as King Wen.
units.literal: In the second year of Emperor Wen's reign, he established Sui's younger brother Piqiang, taking Zhao's Hejian commandery to make him King of Hejian, who became King Wen.

units.zh: 立十三年卒，子哀王福立。
units.en: He reigned for thirteen years and died. His son Fu succeeded him as King Ai.
units.literal: He reigned for thirteen years and died. His son, King Ai Fu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 一年卒，無子，絕後，國除，入于漢。
units.en: He reigned for just one year before dying without an heir. The line was extinguished, the state abolished, and the territory reverted to Han.
units.literal: He reigned for one year and died without sons. The line was extinguished. The state was abolished and reverted to Han.

units.zh: 遂既王趙二十六年，孝景帝時坐晁錯以適削趙王常山之郡。
units.en: After Sui had been King of Zhao for twenty-six years, in Emperor Jing's time, because of Chao Cuo's plan to reduce the feudal domains, the commandery of Changshan was stripped from his domain.
units.literal: Sui had been king of Zhao for twenty-six years when, in Emperor Jing's time, on account of Chao Cuo's policy of reducing the feudal domains, the Changshan commandery was stripped from the Zhao king.

units.zh: 吳楚反，趙王遂與合謀起兵。
units.en: When Wu and Chu rose in rebellion, King Sui of Zhao joined the conspiracy and raised his own troops.
units.literal: When Wu and Chu rebelled, King Zhao Sui conspired with them and raised troops.

units.zh: 其相建德、內史王悍諫，不聽。
units.en: His chancellor Jiande and Interior Minister Wang Han remonstrated with him, but he would not listen.
units.literal: His chancellor Jiande and interior minister Wang Han advised against it, but he wouldn't listen.

units.zh: 遂燒殺建德、王悍，發兵屯其西界，欲待吳與俱西。
units.en: Sui had Jiande and Wang Han burned alive, deployed troops to garrison his western border, and planned to wait for the forces of Wu before advancing west together.
units.literal: Sui burned and killed Jiande and Wang Han, sent troops to garrison his western border, and wished to wait for Wu to advance west together.

units.zh: 北使匈奴，與連和攻漢。
units.en: He dispatched envoys northward to the Xiongnu, seeking an alliance to jointly attack Han.
units.literal: He sent envoys north to the Xiongnu, allied with them, and planned to attack Han.

units.zh: 漢使曲周侯酈寄擊之。
units.en: Han dispatched Li Ji, the Marquis of Quzhou, to attack him.
units.literal: Han sent Marquis Quzhou Li Ji to attack him.

units.zh: 趙王遂還，城守邯鄲，相距七月。
units.en: King Sui of Zhao withdrew and fortified Handan. The two sides held each other at bay for seven months.
units.literal: King Zhao Sui returned and defended Handan. They confronted each other for seven months.

units.zh: 吳楚敗於梁，不能西。
units.en: Wu and Chu were defeated at Liang and could advance no further west.
units.literal: Wu and Chu were defeated at Liang and could not advance west.

units.zh: 匈奴聞之，亦止，不肯入漢邊。
units.en: When the Xiongnu learned of this, they too held back and refused to cross into Han territory.
units.literal: The Xiongnu heard about this and also stopped, refusing to enter Han territory.

units.zh: 欒布自破齊還，乃并兵引水灌趙城。
units.en: Luan Bu, returning from his victory over Qi, combined his forces and diverted the river to flood the Zhao capital.
units.literal: Luan Bu returned from defeating Qi and combined forces to divert water and flood Zhao city.

units.zh: 趙城壞，趙王自殺，邯鄲遂降。
units.en: The walls of Zhao collapsed. The King of Zhao took his own life, and Handan surrendered.
units.literal: Zhao city was breached. King Zhao committed suicide. Handan surrendered.

units.zh: 趙幽王絕後。
units.en: The line of King You of Zhao was thus extinguished.
units.literal: The line of King Zhao You was extinguished.

units.zh: 太史公曰：國之將興，必有禎祥，君子用而小人退。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: When a state is about to rise, auspicious signs are sure to appear—the worthy are given office and the petty retreat.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: When a state is about to flourish, there will certainly be auspicious omens, the worthy are employed and the petty withdraw.

units.zh: 國之將亡，賢人隱，亂臣貴。
units.en: When a state is about to fall, the wise withdraw into seclusion and the treacherous are elevated.
units.literal: When a state is about to perish, the worthy hide themselves and traitors are honored.

units.zh: 使楚王戊毋刑申公，遵其言，趙任防與先生，豈有篡殺之謀，為天下僇哉？
units.en: Had King Wu of Chu not punished Master Shen but heeded his counsel, and had Zhao entrusted its affairs to Master Fangyu, how could there have been conspiracies of usurpation and bloodshed, bringing shame upon the realm?
units.literal: If King Wu of Chu had not punished Master Shen and had followed his counsel, and if Zhao had employed Master Fangyu, how could there have been plots of usurpation and murder, bringing disgrace upon the realm?

units.zh: 賢人乎，賢人乎！
units.en: O, the worthy! O, the worthy!
units.literal: Ah, the worthy! Ah, the worthy!

units.zh: 非質有其內，惡能用之哉？
units.en: Without possessing true substance within oneself, how can one make use of the worthy?
units.literal: If one does not possess the substance within, how can one employ it?

units.zh: 甚矣，「安危在出令，存亡在所任」，誠哉是言也！
units.en: How profoundly true is the saying: 'Whether a state knows security or peril depends on the decrees it issues; whether it survives or perishes depends on whom it appoints'—these words ring true indeed!
units.literal: How true it is that 'security and danger lie in issuing commands, survival and extinction lie in whom one employs'—truly this saying is correct!

findings.action: Replace the four interval attestations with source-undated attestations preserving the anecdote; retain Gaozu’s independently dated BC 201 chapter context only, and remove the unsupported active ranges.

findings.action: Replace the active hint with the directly supported BC 181 context or remove the unproven start; do not infer a lifespan or accession year.

findings.action: Replace the point-bearing attestation with an undated attribution and remove the BC 100 active hint.
